item.text: I’m opening the reconstructed filing and searching for the year-end debt disclosure, then I’ll return the shortest document-backed value.
`rg` isn’t installed here, so I’m using a quick JSON scan to find the debt note and extract the exact year-end amount.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json, re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/COSTCO_2015_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data.get('texts',[])
patterns=[re.compile(p,re.I) for p in ['long-term debt','debt at year-end','year-end','maturit','borrowings','notes payable']]
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    txt=t.get('text','')
    if any(p.search(txt) for p in patterns):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'TEXT',txt[:500].replace('\\n',' '))
PY"
